audience: As a candidate for this Microsoft Certification, you should have experience using generative AI-powered productivity tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Cowork, and pre-built agents. You take advantage of AI and Work IQ to improve daily work, drive business outcomes, and make informed decisions in business contexts without building AI apps or writing code.

You should have experience using elements of generative AI, such as prompt engineering, context engineering, and large language models, and using Microsoft 365 Copilot tools such as notebooks and pages. You should understand how these elements are used to drive more efficient business outcomes.

You should be comfortable using Microsoft 365 core apps such as Outlook, Word, Microsoft Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel. You should be familiar with common business processes, including drafting emails, creating presentations, generating images, and managing documents.

sections.title: Understand generative AI capabilities across Microsoft 365 experiences
skills: Understand how Copilot works to keep your organization’s information private and secure
Understand how the context, like Work IQ, web data, or the app you’re using, can affect Copilot responses
Understand when to use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat, agents, and Microsoft Copilot Cowork
Understand the differences in features and capabilities across Copilot experiences and Microsoft 365 apps

sections.title: Identify responsible AI and data protection practices
skills: Identify common risks, including inaccuracies, prompt injection, and over-reliance
Select verification steps appropriate to the task, including citation checks and human review
Recognize and mitigate risks to sensitive data
Understand how data protection restricts prompt results
